name: Eclipse
author: Erin Carter
description: A minutes-long lunar eclipse: a softly mottled moon hangs in a near-black starfield while a warm-edged umbral shadow slides across it, smouldering ember-red and graded toward the trailing limb at brief totality before light returns from the opposite limb.

params.label: Eclipse period
params.effect: Seconds for the full shadow transit cycle; the whole event compresses to half a minute or stretches to six.

params.label: Moon radius
params.effect: Radius of the moon disc in CSS pixels, from a distant small moon to a frame-filling close-up.

params.label: Ember
params.effect: Warm tint strength of the shadowed portion and totality glow, from near-black occlusion to a deep smouldering red disc.

params.label: Mottle
params.effect: Contrast of the FBM maria texture on the disc, from a smooth porcelain moon to strongly marked dark seas.
